label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User-controlled param flows directly to openStream() sink via URL u. While isNonPublicAddress() guards against common local addresses, DNS rebinding and redirect attacks remain viable - the initial DNS resolution check does not persistently validate the actual connection target. Resolved sink value: new java.net.URL(u).openStream() where u = param (user input).

evidence.note: User param flows to u, then to openStream() sink without persistent validation
